perceptionBackend.title: Perception backend
perceptionBackend.subtitle: Choose which path runs video perception. The two are mutually exclusive and switching takes effect immediately.
perceptionBackend.cloudDesc: Uses the multimodal model configured below. Requires an API key and bills per token; supports audio and identity.
perceptionBackend.localDesc: Uses a vision model service on this machine or LAN. No key, no token cost, footage never leaves home.
perceptionBackend.switchedCloud: Switched to the cloud API path
perceptionBackend.switchedLocal: Switched to the local GPU path
perceptionBackend.capNoKey: The local path needs no model-provider API key.
perceptionBackend.capNoAudio: Vision only: no speech commands or ambient-sound conclusions (use the cloud path if you need audio).
perceptionBackend.capNoIdentity: No identity recognition — scene description and rule judgment only.
perceptionBackend.capNoStatic: The local path performs no device actions. If rules with direct device control are enabled, switching is refused and they are listed — disable them or convert them to agent-decided dynamic rules first.
perceptionBackend.blockingRulesLocal: These enabled rules carry direct device actions; on this path they will not run (a hit is recorded as a failed trigger):
perceptionBackend.capNoSuggestions: No proactive suggestions: it produces scene descriptions and rule verdicts only.
perceptionBackend.backendConfigured: (configured at startup; the effective path is chosen per request)
perceptionBackend.loadingModel: The sidecar is still loading its model; try switching shortly
perceptionBackend.setupHint: Requires running the sidecar yourself — see services/local-vision/README.md in the repo
